prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Compact Layout Adoption Certificate Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a compact layout to streamline pet naming and final confirmation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Finalize Your Companion's Adoption", "body": "Name your desktop pet and issue its certificate to complete setup."}}
1: [sign_in, redesign] Two Column Sign In Protection Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a two-column layout that clearly presents account sign-in alongside pet sync protection details.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Signing in ensures your pet state, memories, and custom visuals remain synced across sessions."}}
2: [finish, redesign] Checklist Layout Home Intro Redesign: Redesign the final onboarding home intro screen with a checklist layout outlining key desktop interactions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "body": "Review the quick start checklist below to interact with and summon your pet anytime."}}
3: [home, redesign] Spotlight Layout Waiting Screen Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen using a spotlight layout focused on active background companion preparation status.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace", "body": "We are generating your desktop companion files and configuring background permissions."}}
4: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Personality Trait Selection Screen: Insert a new personality trait selection screen right after pick_friend to let users customize companion behavior.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_personality_traits", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_personality_traits": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Choose Your Pet's Personality", "body": "Select how playful or quiet your pet should be on your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Personality Traits", "style": "playful"}]}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Selection Direct Headline Copy: Update headline and body on choose_path screen to state choices explicitly without abstract narrative language.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How You Want to Create Your Pet", "body": "Select a ready-to-use pet or upload photos to generate a unique custom companion."}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Account Preservation Sign In Safety Hint: Add an explicit safety hint below the sign in form confirming pet progress is saved automatically.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Your pet customization and adoption progress will be linked directly to this account."}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Custom Pet Fast Generation Seal Incentive: Display a quality guarantee badge on the adoption certificate screen reassuring users of successful rendering.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Instant Pet Generation Guaranteed", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Status Wait Info: Enable progress bar and hint text detailing system tray and rendering initialization during the wait step.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Initializing local desktop renderer and setting up system tray shortcut...", "show_progress": true}}
9: [finish, notification] Desktop Control Shortcut Home Notification: Enable ready notification toggle and add control tip component on home intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Tip: Press your hotkey or right-click the system tray icon to hide or interact with your pet."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate into a compact layout retains the step and screen job without violating base rules.
Two-column layout redesign for sign-in keeps the sign-in step intact and provides clear account protection context.
Checklist layout redesign for the home intro screen stays within onboarding and maintains required functionality.
Spotlight layout redesign for the waiting screen clearly shows background companion preparation status.
Adding a new personality trait selection screen inside onboarding flow is allowed by Rule 4.
Explicit copy on choose_path clearly offers both ready-to-use pets and custom photo uploads.
Adding a safety hint to the sign-in screen is a permitted onboarding copy update.
Adding a quality guarantee badge on the adoption certificate does not violate pricing or dark pattern rules.
Enabling progress bar and status text on the waiting screen accurately reflects the real pet preparation step.
Adding a ready notification toggle and control tip to home_intro is an allowed onboarding modification.
